title: The context window is the model's desk
objective: Learners see that everything an AI assistant works with during a long session (instructions, messages, file reads and other tool results) has to fit in a fixed context window; when the next turn would push usage past a threshold, older turns are compacted into a much smaller summary that keeps only the gist of some facts and drops details, while facts saved to a notes file stay exact.

recommended.why: A desk that visibly fills with coloured blocks toward a red limit line, and gets squashed into a summary, makes the limit and compaction feel physical.

alternative.why: A desk you can see filling up versus a usage chart: which makes compaction intuitive?

assumptions: Illustrative sizes: a 200k-token limit, 12k tokens of fixed instructions, and seeded per-turn sizes for each message, tool result and reply; real assistants and models differ
Each turn is one user message, one tool result (a file read or search) and one reply; Small tool results are 1.2k to 4.8k tokens, Large ones 9k to 24k

Compaction is simplified: when the next turn would push usage past 90% of the limit, all but the 2 most recent turns (plus any earlier summary) are replaced by a summary 12% of their size. Many assistants compact older turns in some similar way
In a summary, headline facts survive as a gist, some survive as a gist only once, and details are lost; a summary of a summary keeps only headlines
With notes on, the assistant writes each fact to plan.md when it is mentioned and re-reads that small file after each compaction (300 tokens plus 150 per fact)
units: turns: one message, tool result and reply each
checkDescription: Usage never exceeds the limit, compaction happens exactly when the next turn would cross the 90% threshold, the tokens before and after each compaction add up (folded turns out, a 12% summary in), and with notes on no mentioned fact is lost or reduced to a gist.

learnerPrompts.predict: Before you play it: after 28 turns with large file reads, which of the eight facts do you expect the assistant still knows word for word?
learnerPrompts.explain: Switch Save notes to a file to Yes. Why does a tiny plan.md protect every fact, while a summary many times its size still loses the go-live date?
